description.plain:
CARD 1

Business Questions & Audience

Dashboard overview and business context

Dashboard Overview

Dashboard Name: Revenue Analytics & Profitability Intelligence

Purpose: Bring executive revenue performance, customer contribution and product/material profitability into one connected SAP Analytics Cloud experience, supported by the demonstrated Joule conversational scenarios.

Business Problem

Revenue, gross profit and margin information can be difficult to interpret when executive, customer and product views are reviewed separately. Decision-makers need a consistent way to monitor performance, identify customer and product contribution, and investigate margin movement.

Target Audience

Persona — Purpose

Executive Leadership / CFO — Review revenue, gross profit, gross margin and overall commercial performance.

Sales Leadership — Monitor revenue movement across geography and sales groups and identify areas requiring follow-up.

Customer / Account Managers — Compare customer-segment contribution, customer-group performance and top customers by revenue.

Product / Portfolio Managers — Review product-group revenue and gross profit, category margin and material contribution.

Finance / Commercial Analysts — Investigate margin performance and explain variance using the demonstrated analytical views.

Business Users — Use the demonstrated Joule scenarios to ask margin questions and explore a what-if margin change.

Three Key Business Questions

How are revenue, gross profit, gross margin and quantity performing over time, geography and sales groups?

Which customer segments, customer groups and individual customers contribute most to revenue and gross profit?

Which product groups and materials contribute most to gross profit, and how does profitability compare with sales quantity?

Problem Today

The solution organises the analysis into three SAC perspectives—Executive Performance, Customer Performance, and Product & Material Profitability—with Joule examples for margin-rate lookup, variance explanation and scenario exploration.

description.plain:
CARD 4

Data Sources

Logical source architecture, analytical layers and documented technical boundaries

Data Architecture

Logical Source-to-Insight Flow

The deck confirms the logical source-to-insight flow only. Exact deployed technical object names and field-level lineage were not included.

Business Domain — Dashboard Evidence / Analysis — Technical Evidence Status

Executive — Revenue, gross profit, margin, quantity, customer count, quarterly trend, geography and sales-group analysis. — Dashboard capability confirmed; formulas and field lineage not supplied.

Customer — Segment contribution, top customers, customer-group revenue/profit and customer/material detail. — Dashboard capability confirmed; customer keys/ranking logic not supplied.

Product / Material — Product-group revenue/profit, profitability vs quantity, category margin and top materials by gross profit. — Dashboard capability confirmed; hierarchy, unit and cost basis not supplied.

Joule – Margin — Margin-rate lookup and month-to-month variance explanation. — Demonstrated scenario; data caveat applies.

Joule – Scenario — 5-point margin reduction vs stated sales target; margin by horsepower category. — Calculation detail and production validation not supplied.

Technical Inventory — CDS views, Datasphere objects, analytical model, SAC model and refresh schedule. — Open: confirm deployed names and lineage.

Business Definitions — KPI formulas, currency/unit rules, date filters, targets and calculation logic. — Open: obtain business-owner sign-off.

Data Governance — Data quality, reconciliation, access control and refresh monitoring. — Open: not specified in the supplied deck.
